2027-04-04.title: Second Sunday of Easter (Sunday of Divine Mercy)
readings: The whole group of those who believed were of one heart and soul
Give thanks to the Lord for he is good, his love is everlasting (or: Alleluia)
Whatever is born of God conquers the world
Christians, to the Paschal Victim offer your thankful praises
A week later Jesus came and stood among them
2027-04-04.verse: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!” Jesus said to him, “Have you believed because you have seen me? Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have come to believe.”

2027-04-11.title: Third Sunday of Easter
readings: You killed the Author of life, whom God raised from the dead
Lord, let your face shine on us (or: Alleluia)
He is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only but also for the sins of the whole world
Thus it is written, that the Messiah is to suffer and to rise from the dead on the third day
2027-04-11.verse: Look at my hands and my feet; see that it is I myself. Touch me and see; for a ghost does not have flesh and bones as you see that I have.

2027-04-18.title: Fourth Sunday of Easter (Good Shepherd Sunday)
readings: There is salvation in no one else; there is no other name under heaven by which we must be saved
The stone rejected by the builders has become the cornerstone (or: Alleluia)
See what love the Father has given us, that we should be called children of God; we will see him as he is
The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep
2027-04-18.verse: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

2027-04-25.title: Fifth Sunday of Easter
readings: Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles
I will praise you, Lord, in the assembly of your people (or: Alleluia)
Let us love, not in word or speech, but in truth and action
I am the vine, you are the branches
2027-04-25.verse: I am the vine, you are the branches. Those who abide in me and I in them bear much fruit, because apart from me you can do nothing.

2027-04-01.title: Thursday within the Octave of Easter
readings: You killed the Author of life, whom God raised from the dead. To this we are witnesses
O Lord, our God, how wonderful your name in all the earth! (or: Alleluia)
Thus it is written, that the Messiah is to suffer and to rise from the dead on the third day
2027-04-01.verse: Look at my hands and my feet; see that it is I myself. Touch me and see; for a ghost does not have flesh and bones as you see that I have.

2027-04-02.title: Friday within the Octave of Easter
readings: There is salvation in no one else: there is no other name under heaven by which we must be saved
The stone rejected by the builders has become the cornerstone (or: Alleluia)
Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and did the same with the fish
2027-04-02.verse: That disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It is the Lord!”

2027-04-03.title: Saturday within the Octave of Easter
readings: We cannot keep from speaking about what we have seen and heard
I praise you, Lord, for you have answered me (or: Alleluia)
Go into all the world and proclaim the good news to the whole creation
2027-04-03.verse: And he said to them, “Go into all the world and proclaim the good news to the whole creation.”

2027-04-05.title: The Annunciation of the Lord (transferred from 25 March)
readings: Look, the virgin shall conceive and bear a son, and shall name him Emmanuel, for God is with us
Here I am, Lord; I come to do your will
See, I have come to do your will, O God
You will conceive in your womb and bear a son
2027-04-05.verse: Then Mary said, “Here am I, the servant of the Lord; let it be with me according to your word.”

2027-04-06.title: Tuesday of the Second Week of Easter
readings: The community of believers was of one heart and soul
The Lord is king; he is robed in majesty (or: Alleluia)
No one has gone up to heaven except the one who came down from heaven, the Son of Man
2027-04-06.verse: And just as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, so must the Son of Man be lifted up, that whoever believes in him may have eternal life.

2027-04-07.title: St John Baptist de la Salle, priest (memorial)
readings: The men you put in prison are standing in the temple and teaching the people
The Lord hears the cry of the poor (or: Alleluia)
God sent his Son that the world might be saved through him
2027-04-07.verse: Indeed, God did not send the Son into the world to condemn the world, but in order that the world might be saved through him.

2027-04-08.title: Thursday of the Second Week of Easter
readings: We are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit
The Lord hears the cry of the poor (or: Alleluia)
The Father loves the Son and has placed all things in his hands
2027-04-08.verse: He whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for he gives the Spirit without measure.

2027-04-09.title: Friday of the Second Week of Easter
readings: They rejoiced that they were considered worthy to suffer dishonor for the sake of the name
One thing I seek: to dwell in the house of the Lord (or: Alleluia)
He distributed to those who were seated as much as they wanted
2027-04-09.verse: Then Jesus took the loaves, and when he had given thanks, he distributed them to those who were seated; so also the fish, as much as they wanted.

2027-04-10.title: Saturday of the Second Week of Easter
readings: They chose seven men full of the Holy Spirit
Lord, let your mercy be on us, as we place our trust in you (or: Alleluia)
They saw Jesus walking on the sea
2027-04-10.verse: But he said to them, “It is I; do not be afraid.”

2027-04-12.title: Monday of the Third Week of Easter
readings: They could not withstand the wisdom and the Spirit with which Stephen spoke; his face was like the face of an angel
Blessed are they who follow the law of the Lord! (or: Alleluia)
Do not work for the food that perishes, but for the food that endures for eternal life
2027-04-12.verse: Do not work for the food that perishes, but for the food that endures for eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you.

2027-04-13.title: Tuesday of the Third Week of Easter
readings: Lord Jesus, receive my spirit. Lord, do not hold this sin against them
Into your hands, O Lord, I commend my spirit (or: Alleluia)
It was not Moses who gave you the bread from heaven; my Father gives you the true bread from heaven
2027-04-13.verse: I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

2027-04-14.title: Wednesday of the Third Week of Easter
readings: Those who were scattered went from place to place, proclaiming the word; there was great joy in that city
Let all the earth cry out to God with joy (or: Alleluia)
This is the will of my Father, that all who see the Son and believe in him may have eternal life
2027-04-14.verse: This is indeed the will of my Father, that all who see the Son and believe in him may have eternal life; and I will raise them up on the last day.

2027-04-15.title: Thursday of the Third Week of Easter
readings: Look, here is water! What is to prevent me from being baptized?
Let all the earth cry out to God with joy (or: Alleluia)
I am the living bread that came down from heaven
2027-04-15.verse: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. Whoever eats of this bread will live forever; and the bread that I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.

2027-04-16.title: Friday of the Third Week of Easter
readings: He is an instrument whom I have chosen to bring my name before Gentiles and kings and before the people of Israel
Go out to all the world and tell the Good News (or: Alleluia)
My flesh is true food and my blood is true drink
2027-04-16.verse: Those who eat my flesh and drink my blood abide in me, and I in them.

2027-04-17.title: Saturday of the Third Week of Easter
readings: Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Tabitha, get up
How shall I make a return to the Lord for all the good he has done for me? (or: Alleluia)
Lord, to whom can we go? You have the words of eternal life
2027-04-17.verse: Lord, to whom can we go? You have the words of eternal life.

2027-04-19.title: Monday of the Fourth Week of Easter
readings: God has given even to the Gentiles the repentance that leads to life
My soul thirsts for God, for the living God (or: Alleluia)
I am the gate for the sheep
2027-04-19.verse: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I came that they may have life, and have it abundantly.

2027-04-20.title: Tuesday of the Fourth Week of Easter
readings: They spoke to the Hellenists also, proclaiming the Lord Jesus
All you nations, praise the Lord (or: Alleluia)
The Father and I are one
2027-04-20.verse: My sheep hear my voice. I know them, and they follow me. I give them eternal life, and they will never perish.

2027-04-21.title: Wednesday of the Fourth Week of Easter · St Anselm
readings: Set apart for me Barnabas and Saul
O God, let all the nations praise you! (or: Alleluia)
I have come as light into the world
2027-04-21.verse: I have come as light into the world, so that everyone who believes in me should not remain in the darkness.

2027-04-22.title: Thursday of the Fourth Week of Easter
readings: Of this man's posterity God has brought to Israel a Savior, Jesus, as he promised
For ever I will sing the goodness of the Lord (or: Alleluia)
Whoever receives one whom I send receives me
2027-04-22.verse: Very truly, I tell you, whoever receives one whom I send receives me; and whoever receives me receives him who sent me.

2027-04-23.title: Friday of the Fourth Week of Easter · St George; St Adalbert
readings: God has fulfilled his promise by raising Jesus
You are my Son; this day I have begotten you (or: Alleluia)
I am the way, and the truth, and the life
2027-04-23.verse: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.”

2027-04-24.title: Saturday of the Fourth Week of Easter · St Fidelis of Sigmaringen
readings: We are now turning to the Gentiles
All the ends of the earth have seen the saving power of God (or: Alleluia)
Whoever has seen me has seen the Father
2027-04-24.verse: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you all this time, Philip, and you still do not know me? Whoever has seen me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?”

2027-04-26.title: Monday of the Fifth Week of Easter
readings: We bring you good news, that you should turn from these worthless things to the living God
Not to us, O Lord, but to your name give the glory (or: Alleluia)
The Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you everything
2027-04-26.verse: Jesus answered him, “Those who love me will keep my word, and my Father will love them, and we will come to them and make our home with them.”

2027-04-27.title: Tuesday of the Fifth Week of Easter
readings: They called the church together and related all that God had done with them, and how he had opened a door of faith for the Gentiles
Your friends make known, O Lord, the glorious splendour of your kingdom (or: Alleluia)
My peace I give to you
2027-04-27.verse: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled, and do not let them be afraid.

2027-04-28.title: Wednesday of the Fifth Week of Easter · St Peter Chanel; St Louis Grignion de Montfort
readings: They went up to Jerusalem to the apostles and the elders to discuss this question
Let us go rejoicing to the house of the Lord (or: Alleluia)
Those who abide in me and I in them bear much fruit
2027-04-28.verse: I am the vine, you are the branches. Those who abide in me and I in them bear much fruit, because apart from me you can do nothing.

2027-04-29.title: Saint Catherine of Siena, Virgin and Doctor of the Church
readings: God has made no distinction between them and us, cleansing their hearts by faith
Proclaim his marvellous deeds to all the nations (or: Alleluia)
Abide in my love, so that my joy may be in you, and that your joy may be complete
2027-04-29.verse: As the Father has loved me, so I have loved you; abide in my love.

2027-04-30.title: Friday of the Fifth Week of Easter · St Pius V
readings: It has seemed good to the Holy Spirit and to us to impose on you no further burden than these essentials
I will give you thanks among the peoples, O Lord (or: Alleluia)
This is my commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you
2027-04-30.verse: This is my commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.

kidsaint: St John Baptist de la Salle
